inputs.text: [excited] It was 2 meters long — [quickly] as long as a motorcycle! Standing up, it was 0.9 meters tall — as tall as a 4-year-old! And it weighed 35 kilos — [proud] as heavy as a big 10-year-old.
[curious] And its crest, what was that for?
[confident] Probably to look good, [playful] a bit like a peacock's tail.
